national_ai_framework_2026.text: As AI continues to rapidly evolve, we need regulations at home and abroad. I’ve joined @RepYassAnsari and over 40 of my House Democratic colleagues in urging the Trump Administration to establish a coordinated global framework with our allies to regulate AI development. Especially as we grapple with the uncertainty of these advancements, it’s all the more important to work with our longstanding allies to ensure true global security.

deepseek.reason: The statement urges a coordinated global framework with allies, not the White House's March 2026 national AI legislative framework.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The proposal described is a global regulatory framework, not the specific 2026 national framework.
